To: Lily Chen <lily.chen@acmehealth.com>, Alan McBride <alan.mcbride@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Handoff cadence & launch commitments / target launch 2025-12-18

Hi Lily / Alan —

Thanks for the productive call today. As discussed, I’m consolidating the mutual action plan (MAP) items and proposing a tight cadence to hit the target launch date of 2025-12-18. Please review the high-level timeline below and confirm ownership for the runbook and cutover activities.

Proposed top-level milestones:
- 2025-12-08: Finalize procurement / SOW sign-off (Acme)
- 2025-12-12: Final security checklist & SOC2 evidence exchange
- 2025-12-15: Dry-run cutover (internal + 1 Acme SME)
- 2025-12-18: Production cutover / go-live (target)

Immediate asks:
1) Can Acme confirm procurement sign-off window (expected by 12/08)?
2) Internal owners: who will own the runbook and who will coordinate the rollback verification?
3) Any required playground/test account credentials we should provision ahead of the dry-run?

I’ve attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet with actions and owners (MAP_v1.xlsx). I’ll hold weekly check-ins (this thread) — next sync is Tuesday 2025-12-09 10:00 PT if that works for everyone.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199

Date: 2025-12-02T10:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff cadence & launch commitments / target launch 2025-12-18

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the MAP spreadsheet. Quick answers:

- Procurement: we are tracking to complete commercial review and internal approval by COB 2025-12-08. I’ve looped procurement@acmehealth.com on this thread; they’ll confirm any final redlines by end of week.
- SOC2 / security: we need the SOC2 evidence bundle and the data flow diagram by 2025-12-12 to route through security review. Can you send the most recent evidence pack?
- Test accounts: yes — please provision a staging tenant and a sandbox API key with limited token quotas. We’ll share a point of contact for the dry-run.

I attached the draft SOW Acme prepared (Acme_SOW_draft.pdf). Please note section 3.2 (rollback acceptance criteria) — we’d like clarity on RTO / RPO in the runbook.

Appreciate the Tuesday sync — I’ll confirm availability for our SMEs.

Best,
Lily Chen
Program Manager, Digital Platform | Acme Health
Lily.Chen@acmehealth.com
Attachments: Acme_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Lily — got it on procurement and SOC2 timing. Quick internal ownership notes from our side so everyone knows who to pull on for the dry-run and cutover: 

Ownership (Redwood):
- Runbook author & runbook lead: Neha Kapoor (I'll own the runbook_draft.md and coordinate test steps).
- Cutover execution lead: Ben Carter (will run the actual switch and monitor metrics).
- Rollback / fallback verification: Monica Patel (will validate rollback path and accept criteria).

Action items I’m adding to the MAP_v1.xlsx and attaching an early runbook draft. The runbook will include: pre-cutover checklist, smoke tests, post-cutover verification, rollback steps with automated signals to trigger rollback, and contact matrix.

Attachments: runbook_draft.md (text)

Subject: Re: Handoff cadence & launch commitments / target launch 2025-12-18 — weekly checkpoint 2025-12-08

Team — quick weekly checkpoint and consolidated actions after internal alignment. Please reply with "ACK" or a short update on any open items.

Summary (status as of 2025-12-08):
- Procurement: Lily confirmed legal/commercial review target COB 12/08 (Acme). (ACTION: procurement@acmehealth.com to confirm signing timeline)
- SOC2 evidence: Redwood to provide evidence bundle & data flow diagram by 12/12. (ACTION: Neha to upload evidence links)
- Runbook: Neha to finalize runbook draft by 12/10; Ben to schedule dry-run steps and the staging tenant. (ACTION: Neha/Ben)
- Dry-run: planned for 12/15 with one Acme SME in the room for verification. (ACTION: Lily to nominate SME)
- Rollback acceptance criteria: referenced in Acme SOW section 3.2 — Monica to reconcile SOW language with runbook RTO/RPO definitions. (ACTION: Monica)

Action items (owner / due):
1) procurement@acmehealth.com — confirm SOW sign-off or redlines (due 2025-12-08)
2) Neha Kapoor — upload SOC2 evidence bundle + data flow diagram (due 2025-12-12)
3) Ben Carter — provision staging tenant & schedule dry-run; share access instructions (due 2025-12-13)
4) Monica Patel — publish rollback acceptance criteria and validate test cases (due 2025-12-11)
5) Jonas Weber — update MAP_v1.xlsx with the above and circulate final pre-cutover checklist (due 2025-12-10)

Quick notes: please flag any blockers now — we want one clear cross-company runbook and an agreed rollback decision tree ahead of the dry-run. If procurement slips beyond 12/08, we’ll need to discuss contingency windows (backup launch 2025-12-22) — call this out explicitly in your ACK.

Thanks all — looking forward to short ACKs.
